en: Black‑and‑white waterfront view of a historic European city. In the foreground are several steam-powered boats and small ships on a broad river or canal. On the right bank stand narrow gabled merchant houses and warehouses. In the background rise large brick churches with tall towers typical of North German / Baltic architecture. The overall look is early‑20th‑century harbor life in an old Hanseatic city.
